dct_description_sm:
Preprint version of the manuscript:
Timothy Rodgers, Amanda Giang, Miriam Diamond et al. Where do they come from, where do they go? Emissions and fate of OPEs in global megacities, 07 December 2022, PREPRINT (Version 1) available at Research Square [https://doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.rs-2273755/v1]

This data has been collected to parameterize the Multimedia Urban Model for 19 different mega or major cities. The data collected here can be used with the model, which is available from https://github.com/tfmrodge/FugModel, to estimate the transport and fate of organic contaminants from urban areas.
